name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
description: A short gradient beam (#ffaa40 to #9c40ff) travels around the border of a card or button, one lap every 6 s, linear, looping for as long as the shot holds.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.borderBeam(q(".login .mw-border-beam"), tl, 0, { duration: 8, size: 200, borderWidth: 3, hold: 8 });

options.hold: seconds it runs in the film (10)

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Put .mw-border-beam inside any element with position: relative and a border-radius; it inherits the radius. AE: pictures (gradient on a path).
